overloads.semanticRole: The QR SET SORTS command sets the sort orders for the columns in the report whose reference is passed in area .

constraints: aColumns and aOrders are parallel arrays: aOrders{i} gives the sort order for the column number stored in aColumns{i}.
Each aOrders element must be 1 (ascending) or -1 (descending).
In cross-table mode, the arrays cannot have more than two items: only columns (1) and rows (2) can be sorted, not the data at their intersection.
